source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Look up the dates corresponding to the number of infractions on the AirNow chart.
3. For the infractions, look into the hourly ozone level on the chart, and see if any hourly reading goes above 75ppm and last over for a period of 3 hours.
4. For each of this type of readings, take the date and time into account depending on which pollutive_type is selected.
5. Make sure to get the median and the max value of the graph, and corresponding dates, for further references.
6. Finally, repeat the process till the end of monitoring.
7. The data is displayed as following using the template:

